dataset_name: Derived U.S. rates and inflation shock history
attribution: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury. Retrieved from official public endpoints.
license_note: Treasury data is U.S. federal government information. Keep source attribution when reusing the snapshot.
transformation_summary: Joined official 2024 Treasury nominal and real curves and derived level, slope, and breakeven shock diagnostics.

schema.level_bp: Average of 2Y, 5Y, and 10Y nominal yields, basis points
schema.breakeven_10y_bp: Ten-year nominal minus real yield, basis points
schema.delta_10y_bp: Daily ten-year nominal yield change, basis points
schema.delta_real_10y_bp: Daily ten-year real yield change, basis points
schema.delta_breakeven_10y_bp: Daily ten-year breakeven change, basis points
